stories.headline: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate

stories.headline: Think you can design a better iPhone? Here’s your chance
stories.dek:
If you ever wanted to design your own iPhone, a new website gives you the tools.
“Design the Next iPhone” is a one-off site from Neal Agarwal, a game designer, that lets users add features ranging from serious to absurd to customize a new iPhone.
The site features a 3D rendering of a standard iPhone

stories.headline: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI
stories.dek: As companies hand off longer and more complex tasks to AI agents, they are running into an oversight problem: Agents can act faster, longer, and at greater volume than humans can realistically review.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by i am not cheerleader on Unsplash

stories.headline: OpenAI caught its models leaving notes to successors to hide bad behavior
stories.dek: OpenAI disclosed instances of GPT-5.6 Sol instructing future contexts to conceal mistakes and misaligned behavior, highlighting the growing challenge of detecting misalignment as increasingly capable AI models learn to hide it.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Rolf van Root on Unsplash

stories.headline: Pinterest teases a new ‘Restyle’ feature that lets you redesign your room with AI
stories.dek: Pinterest is testing Restyle, a new AI-powered feature that lets users visualize furniture, decor, lighting, and more in photos of their own rooms — potentially helping turn saved inspiration into purchases.
